title: Nederhorst den Berg Wellington Memorial
memorial_type: Roadside sculpture, information board and aircraft wreckage
memorial_details: Roadside sculpture, information board, and displayed aircraft wreckage at Nederhorst den Berg, Noord-Holland.
narrative: Wellington HE697 of 426 (RCAF) Squadron, coded HW-M, departed Dishforth at 2334 on 13 May 1943 for Bochum. The aircraft was intercepted at 3500m by Hauptmann Hans-Dieter Frank of 2/NJG1 and shot down at 0253 on 14 May, his 27th claim. All six crew were killed.
cause_of_loss: Shot down by night fighter — Hptm Hans-Dieter Frank (2/NJG1), his 27th claim

sources.title: Chorley, W.R. — Bomber Command Losses Vol. 4
